import re
import unicodedata

def slugify(title: str, max_len: int = 50) -> str:
    # 1. Transliterate accented chars to ASCII and drop non-ASCII
    text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', title).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode('ascii')
    # 2. Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # 3. Replace non-alphanumeric runs with "-" and strip leading/trailing "-"
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text).strip('-')
    
    # 4 & 5. Truncate to max_len without cutting words, ensure no trailing "-"
    if len(text) <= max_len:
        return text

    words = text.split('-')
    if len(words[0]) > max_len:
        return words[0][:max_len]

    parts = [words[0]]
    current_len = len(words[0])
    for word in words[1:]:
        if current_len + 1 + len(word) <= max_len:
            parts.append(word)
            current_len += 1 + len(word)
        else:
            break
            
    return '-'.join(parts)

class TokenBucket:
    def __init__(self, capacity: float, refill_per_sec: float, clock):
        self._capacity = capacity
        self._refill_rate = refill_per_sec
        self._clock = clock
        self._tokens = capacity
        self._last_time = self._clock()

    def _refill(self):
        now = self._clock()
        elapsed = now - self._last_time
        if elapsed > 0:
            # Add tokens proportional to elapsed time
            added = elapsed * self._refill_rate
            # Ensure tokens do not exceed capacity
            self._tokens = min(self._capacity, self._tokens + added)
            self._last_time = now

    def allow(self, cost: float = 1.0) -> bool:
        self._refill()
        if self._tokens >= cost:
            self._tokens -= cost
            return True
        return False

    @property
    def tokens(self) -> float:
        self._refill()
        return self._tokens
